mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1's upward trend, or in contractions where supply indicators (INDPRO) are weak.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%, or during high inflation periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 signals monetary easing and growing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies move in expected directions, or during supply-side constraints.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% amplifies positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 20-day forward returns are not positive when FEDFUNDS drops below 2%, or the effect is not stronger than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO exceeding 105 signals robust supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when INDPRO crosses above 105, or during periods of weak demand.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is rising, or during economic uncertainty.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in UNRATE below 4.0% and rise in PAYEMS above 148,319 signals labor market strengthening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both labor indicators move in expected directions, or during supply-side constraints.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 3% predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when FEDFUNDS drops below 3%, or during prolonged economic stagnation.
